filing.q: Does Akinaza file my tax return?
filing.a: No. Akinaza prepares your GST and QST amounts and their supporting documents; you sign and you file. Akinaza never submits a return.

who.a: Service shops: dog walkers, groomers, salons, repairers. Not for restaurants and bars, which must invoice with a certified cash register.

data.a: In Canada, encrypted at rest. Consent is given per purpose and never pre-ticked; erasure keeps only the invoices the tax law requires.

bilingual.a: Yes, in French and in English, with GST at 5 % and QST at 9.975 % computed to the cent.

engine.a: Its tax assistant will run on Orazaka, Krizaka's engine: planned, not wired yet. The tax amounts come from deterministic code.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Akinaza is in development: only the accounts our team creates can sign in. A shop's data — its clients, appointments, invoices and tax ledger — is kept in Akinaza's database in Canada, encrypted at rest, visible to that shop only. Client consent is recorded per purpose (Loi 25) and can be withdrawn; a client's personal information can be erased, while the invoices tax law requires are kept. When a merchant asks to prepare a tax return, the period's ledger is sent to Orazaka, Krizaka's engine, over HTTPS; nothing is filed or transmitted to any government. Nothing is sold or shared. To ask a question or have your data removed, use the contact form.
